description.value: AlphaSense is a market intelligence and search platform offering AI insights with sentence-level citations.
AlphaSense is a New York-based, AI-driven market intelligence and search platform, founded in 2011 by Jack Kokko and Raj Neervannan.

product_description.value: SuperAnalyst, described as the AI analyst for financial and strategic work, monitors key topics and delivers cited outputs; the platform gives access to over 500 million premium financial and business documents, including Tegus expert transcripts.
AlphaSense Platform, SuperAnalyst, Deep Research, PowerPoint and Excel add-ins, Tegus Expert Insights and Expert Call Services, and Wall Street Insights.
Indexes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news and trade journals; features include semantic search, smart alerts, document summarization and collaboration tools.

business_model_description.value: Revenue comes from subscriptions, priced by number of users, functionality needed and type of data sources included.

customer_description.value: Trusted by 8,000+ of the world's largest enterprises; logos include Pfizer, Microsoft, J.P. Morgan, PG&E and McKesson; case studies include Salesforce, Dow, ODDO BHF, YH2 Capital, Recurve Capital and Royalty Pharma.

Target segments include investment banking, hedge funds, private equity, asset management, venture capital, corporations, consulting, law firms and insurance; named customers include Pfizer, Microsoft, J.P. Morgan, PG&E and McKesson.
Comparison page says it serves 95% of top consultancies, 80% of top asset management firms, 20 largest pharmaceutical companies and 88% of the S&P 100.

revenue.value: Estimates vary: 400M (one profile); $295.8M (StartupHub estimate, range $249.2M to $780.8M); about $200M (third profile).
